historical_floor.note: Histogram is signed error, not estimated log gap.

conditioning.metric: absolute Jacobian l1 and l2 for peak time perturbations; relative to local and final remaining gap; distinguish common shift from independent errors

sweep.sampling: paired masks nested via uniform draw; endpoints retained; noise scaled to local envelope; same latent waveform across perturbations; uniform log-coordinate before deletion; no truth supplied to estimator
sweep.estimator: frozen R4B5 geometric and envelope peak regression; no smoothing or tuning; full-window joint fit diagnostic not held-out predictive decision
sweep.joint: prefix geometric estimate, peak envelope fit on prefix, frozen R4B2 rival screen and R4B3 phase CI on complete signal; evaluate a preregistered subset: 0,0.001,0.01 noise; missing 0,0.3; use same input; record failure stage and ambiguity; no claims of physical validity

pit.limits: diagnostic of fixed zero drift under Gaussian approximation; no calibration or causal distinction from model misspecification alone
